stem: Sea anemones and clown fish live together in the ocean. Which statement best describes one way sea anemones depend on clown fish for an abiotic factor in an ecosystem?

options.label: F
options.text: Clown fish protect sea anemones from predatory fish.

options.label: G
options.text: Clown fish decrease competition among sea anemones.

options.label: H
options.text: Clown fish consume the remains of organisms paralyzed by sea anemones.

options.label: J
options.text: Clown fish move water near sea anemones when dissolved oxygen levels are low.
